# md4c

Vivi vendors md4c release 0.5.3 from
<https://github.com/mity/md4c/tree/release-0.5.3>.

The parser and its generated HTML entity lookup are included:

- `src/md4c.c`
- `src/md4c.h`
- `src/entity.c`
- `src/entity.h`
- `LICENSE.md`

The files are unmodified from that release. Their SHA-256 checksums are:
